gloss: fire sale; dumping; selling at a loss

definitions.gloss: fire sale; dumping; selling at a loss
definitions.explanation: Selling goods at far below their normal price, usually to quickly dispose of inventory. Can also refer to selling assets at a steep discount out of desperation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げ{売|う}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To sell off inventory at fire-sale prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{投|な}げ{売|う}り⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Products were being sold at rock-bottom prices during the closing sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急落|きゅうらく}→急落：09399_kyuuraku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{投資家|とうしか}→投資家：16242_toushika⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{投|な}げ{売|う}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: Stock prices plummeted, and investors rushed to dump their holdings.

notes:
USAGE:
{投|な}げ{売|う}り can describe both physical retail (selling goods cheaply to clear stock) and financial markets (panic selling of stocks or assets). It always implies selling at a significant loss.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投|な}げ{売|う}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sell at a steep discount
- {投|な}げ{売|う}り⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: fire-sale price
- {投|な}げ{売|う}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to rush to dump (assets)
- {投|な}げ{売|う}り⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: a state of dumping

FORMS:
⟦{投|な}げ→投げ：21942_nage⟧ (throw) + ⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧ (selling). The image is of throwing goods away by selling them cheaply.
